test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A. Band C can complete a work in 10, 15 and 25 days, respectively. The time taken by A. B and C together to do the work is:
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete the work in 10 days.

B can complete the work in 15 days.

C can complete the work in 25 days.

**Calculation:**

LCM of 10, 15 , 25 = 150 units.

Efficiency of A = 150/10 = 15 units
